about: Fixed inputs and the bytes the contract's recipe (docs/PAIRING-APPROVAL-API.md, 4.3 and 4.4) produces, for a client to check its own seal/unseal and match-code code against. Every binary value is lowercase hex unless its name ends in _b64url (unpadded base64url).

recipe.match_code: d = SHA-256('prometheus-pair-v1' || 0x00 || requester_public_key(32) || instance_public_key_der || ASCII(request_id)); code = (uint32 big-endian of d[0:4]) mod 10000, zero-padded to 4 digits
recipe.seal: shared = X25519(ephemeral_private, requester_public); key = HKDF-SHA256(shared, salt=ASCII(request_id), info='prometheus-pair-v1/seal', 32 bytes); ciphertext = ChaCha20-Poly1305(key).encrypt(nonce12, plaintext_utf8, aad=ASCII(request_id)) with the 16-byte tag appended
recipe.plaintext: UTF-8 JSON, keys in the order token, device_id, name, no spaces
